The overlays contain 273 matched sentence occurrences and 271 per-lesson unique segmentsByText keys; L3 and L9 each repeat one text surface. The 793 count is multi-atom token rows across those unique per-lesson maps, not a sentence count. Existing loader attaches an overlay only when source commit and dialogue hash match; renderDraftText validates tab-separated nonempty surface/atomId tokens and normalized joined surfaces against the exact sentence text. Valid word surfaces render as lookup buttons (trailing punctuation remains text), using lesson binding lemma/atomId/state when present and SEGMENTS values otherwise.
